title: 雷射干涉位移量測
subcategoryTitle: 光頻標準、慣性感測與干涉量測
subcategoryTitleEn: Optical frequency standards, inertial sensing and interferometric metrology
summary: 以穩頻 HeNe 雙頻雷射與平面鏡干涉儀為對象，從每條紋 λ/4 的相位計數推到次奈米解析度，再把 Edlén 空氣折射率、死程、Abbe 與餘弦誤差、偏振洩漏的週期性非線性整合成可追溯到波長標準的位移量測不確定度預算。
summaryEn: Using a frequency-stabilised two-frequency HeNe laser with a plane-mirror interferometer, go from λ/4-per-fringe phase counting to sub-nanometre resolution, then fold Edlén air index, dead path, Abbe and cosine errors and polarisation-leakage periodic non-linearity into a displacement uncertainty budget traceable to the wavelength standard.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「光程差、條紋與相位細分」與「外差偵測、都卜勒頻移與速度上限」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Optical-path difference, fringes and phase subdivision" and "Heterodyne detection, Doppler shift and the velocity limit": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 光程差、條紋與相位細分：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Optical-path difference, fringes and phase subdivision: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「量測臂、參考臂與相位計」如何決定雷射干涉位移量測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Measurement arm, reference arm and phase meter” determines the key performance of “Laser-interferometric displacement metrology”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 雷射干涉儀把一道相干光分成參考臂與量測臂，量測臂的反射鏡隨待測物移動，兩臂重新合光後的干涉強度隨光程差作週期變化。角隅稜鏡干涉儀中位移 d 使光程差改變 2d，每移動 λ/2 走過一個條紋；平面鏡（雙程）干涉儀讓光束在量測鏡上反射兩次，光程差改變 4d，每 λ/4 一個條紋，對鏡面傾斜不敏感且解析度加倍。電子相位計把一個條紋再細分成數千等分，位移就是條紋數加上相位餘數乘以條紋週期，整個量測的長度單位來自雷射波長。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「量測臂、參考臂與相位計」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A laser interferometer splits one coherent beam into a reference arm and a measurement arm whose mirror moves with the target; after recombination the interference intensity varies periodically with the optical-path difference. In a retroreflector interferometer a displacement d changes the path by 2d, one fringe per λ/2; a plane-mirror (double-pass) interferometer reflects the beam twice from the measurement mirror, so the path changes by 4d, one fringe per λ/4, insensitive to mirror tilt and with doubled resolution. An electronic phase meter subdivides each fringe into thousands of parts, and displacement is fringe count plus phase remainder times fringe period, so the unit of length comes from the laser wavelength. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Measurement arm, reference arm and phase meter”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：雙程干涉儀相位 Δφ = 8πd/λ。
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平面鏡干涉儀每 λ/2 給一個條紋，和角隅稜鏡干涉儀一樣。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A plane-mirror interferometer gives one fringe per λ/2 just like a retroreflector interferometer." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「量測臂、參考臂與相位計」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Measurement arm, reference arm and phase meter”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Optical-path difference, fringes and phase subdivision

knowledge.textEn: A laser interferometer splits one coherent beam into a reference arm and a measurement arm whose mirror moves with the target; after recombination the interference intensity varies periodically with the optical-path difference. In a retroreflector interferometer a displacement d changes the path by 2d, one fringe per λ/2; a plane-mirror (double-pass) interferometer reflects the beam twice from the measurement mirror, so the path changes by 4d, one fringe per λ/4, insensitive to mirror tilt and with doubled resolution.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平面鏡干涉儀每 λ/2 給一個條紋，和角隅稜鏡干涉儀一樣。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A plane-mirror interferometer gives one fringe per λ/2 just like a retroreflector interferometer. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「雷射干涉位移量測」的「光程差、條紋與相位細分：原理與系統邊界」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出試件、激發、光路或訊號路徑與讀出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「大型儀器：校正交班日」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與校正件識別、暗場或零點、原始訊號與取樣設定的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Optical-path difference, fringes and phase subdivision: mechanism and system boundary” in “Laser-interferometric displacement metrology”. Draw the specimen, excitation, optical/signal path and readout boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Large Instruments: Calibration Handoff” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for reference-artifact identity, dark/zero records, raw signals and sampling settings, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「光程差、條紋與相位細分」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Optical-path difference, fringes and phase subdivision" is correct?
options: 平面鏡干涉儀每 λ/2 給一個條紋，和角隅稜鏡干涉儀一樣。
雷射干涉儀把一道相干光分成參考臂與量測臂，量測臂的反射鏡隨待測物移動，兩臂重新合光後的干涉強度隨光程差作週期變化。
外差式干涉儀的解析度由分頻 f_s 決定，f_s 越高解析度越好。
optionsEn: A plane-mirror interferometer gives one fringe per λ/2 just like a retroreflector interferometer.
A laser interferometer splits one coherent beam into a reference arm and a measurement arm whose mirror moves with the target.
Heterodyne resolution is set by the split frequency f_s, so higher f_s means finer resolution.
quiz.explanation: 雷射干涉儀把一道相干光分成參考臂與量測臂，量測臂的反射鏡隨待測物移動，兩臂重新合光後的干涉強度隨光程差作週期變化。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A laser interferometer splits one coherent beam into a reference arm and a measurement arm whose mirror moves with the target; after recombination the interference intensity varies periodically with the optical-path difference. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 光程差、條紋與相位細分：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Optical-path difference, fringes and phase subdivision: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「量測臂、參考臂與相位計」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Measurement arm, reference arm and phase meter” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：雙程干涉儀相位 Δφ = 8πd/λ。穩頻 HeNe 真空波長 λ_vac = 632.99 nm，空氣中 n = 1.000271 時 λ_air = 632.82 nm，條紋週期 λ_air/4 = 158.2 nm；相位計細分 1024 等分時解析度 0.154 nm，4096 等分時 0.039 nm。量測 500 mm 行程要累計 0.5/158.2×10⁻⁹ ≈ 3.16×10⁶ 個條紋，計數電路一個條紋都不能漏。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Double-pass phase Δφ = 8πd/λ. A stabilised HeNe has vacuum wavelength λ_vac = 632.99 nm; in air with n = 1.000271, λ_air = 632.82 nm and the fringe period is λ_air/4 = 158.2 nm; subdividing 1024 ways gives 0.154 nm resolution and 4096 ways gives 0.039 nm. A 500 mm travel accumulates 0.5/158.2×10⁻⁹ ≈ 3.16×10⁶ fringes, and the counter may not miss a single one. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把量測鏡裝在壓電平台上，以已知電壓步進並用電容感測器或校正過的壓電係數對照，確認每 158.2 nm 剛好計到一個條紋、細分讀值在條紋內線性；再做往返行程，檢查歸零後的殘差是否小於一個細分單位，否則有漏計或相位計週期誤差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Mount the measurement mirror on a piezo stage, step it with known voltages against a capacitance sensor or calibrated piezo coefficient, and confirm exactly one fringe per 158.2 nm with linear subdivision inside the fringe; then run a return trip and check that the residual after returning to zero is below one subdivision unit, otherwise fringes are lost or the phase meter has periodic error.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 雙程干涉儀相位 Δφ = 8πd/λ。穩頻 HeNe 真空波長 λ_vac = 632.99 nm，空氣中 n = 1.000271 時 λ_air = 632.82 nm，條紋週期 λ_air/4 = 158.2 nm；相位計細分 1024 等分時解析度 0.154 nm，4096 等分時 0.039 nm。量測 500 mm 行程要累計 0.5/158.2×10⁻⁹ ≈ 3.16×10⁶ 個條紋，計數電路一個條紋都不能漏。
knowledge.textEn: Double-pass phase Δφ = 8πd/λ. A stabilised HeNe has vacuum wavelength λ_vac = 632.99 nm; in air with n = 1.000271, λ_air = 632.82 nm and the fringe period is λ_air/4 = 158.2 nm; subdividing 1024 ways gives 0.154 nm resolution and 4096 ways gives 0.039 nm. A 500 mm travel accumulates 0.5/158.2×10⁻⁹ ≈ 3.16×10⁶ fringes, and the counter may not miss a single one.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「光程差、條紋與相位細分」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Optical-path difference, fringes and phase subdivision", which statement holds?
options: 週期性非線性是隨機雜訊，多次平均就能消除。
干涉儀解析度 0.1 nm，所以量測不確定度也在奈米等級。
雙程干涉儀相位 Δφ = 8πd/λ。
optionsEn: Periodic non-linearity is random noise that averaging removes.
With 0.1 nm resolution the measurement uncertainty is also at the nanometre level.
Double-pass phase Δφ = 8πd/λ.
quiz.explanation: 雙程干涉儀相位 Δφ = 8πd/λ。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Double-pass phase Δφ = 8πd/λ. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 光程差、條紋與相位細分：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Optical-path difference, fringes and phase subdivision: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「量測臂、參考臂與相位計」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Measurement arm, reference arm and phase meter” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 把量測鏡裝在壓電平台上，以已知電壓步進並用電容感測器或校正過的壓電係數對照，確認每 158.2 nm 剛好計到一個條紋、細分讀值在條紋內線性；再做往返行程，檢查歸零後的殘差是否小於一個細分單位，否則有漏計或相位計週期誤差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mount the measurement mirror on a piezo stage, step it with known voltages against a capacitance sensor or calibrated piezo coefficient, and confirm exactly one fringe per 158.2 nm with linear subdivision inside the fringe; then run a return trip and check that the residual after returning to zero is below one subdivision unit, otherwise fringes are lost or the phase meter has periodic error. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：光束被遮斷或訊號強度瞬間低於門檻時計數器掉一個或多個條紋，之後所有讀值都偏移 158.2 nm 的整數倍且無法事後修正；在機台校正中這會表現為突然出現的台階狀誤差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A beam interruption or a momentary drop of signal strength below threshold makes the counter lose one or more fringes, after which every reading is offset by an integer multiple of 158.2 nm with no possibility of later correction; in machine calibration this appears as a sudden step in the error plot.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把量測鏡裝在壓電平台上，以已知電壓步進並用電容感測器或校正過的壓電係數對照，確認每 158.2 nm 剛好計到一個條紋、細分讀值在條紋內線性；再做往返行程，檢查歸零後的殘差是否小於一個細分單位，否則有漏計或相位計週期誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Mount the measurement mirror on a piezo stage, step it with known voltages against a capacitance sensor or calibrated piezo coefficient, and confirm exactly one fringe per 158.2 nm with linear subdivision inside the fringe; then run a return trip and check that the residual after returning to zero is below one subdivision unit, otherwise fringes are lost or the phase meter has periodic error.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「光程差、條紋與相位細分」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Optical-path difference, fringes and phase subdivision"?
options: 把量測鏡裝在壓電平台上，以已知電壓步進並用電容感測器或校正過的壓電係數對照，確認每 158.2 nm 剛好計到一個條紋、細分讀值在條紋內線性。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
干涉儀是光學量測，所以沒有電子延遲問題。
optionsEn: Mount the measurement mirror on a piezo stage, step it with known voltages against a capacitance sensor or calibrated piezo coefficient, and confirm exactly one fringe per 158.2 nm with linear subdivision inside the fringe.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
An interferometer is an optical measurement, so electronic latency is not an issue.
quiz.explanation: 把量測鏡裝在壓電平台上，以已知電壓步進並用電容感測器或校正過的壓電係數對照，確認每 158.2 nm 剛好計到一個條紋、細分讀值在條紋內線性；再做往返行程，檢查歸零後的殘差是否小於一個細分單位，否則有漏計或相位計週期誤差。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Mount the measurement mirror on a piezo stage, step it with known voltages against a capacitance sensor or calibrated piezo coefficient, and confirm exactly one fringe per 158.2 nm with linear subdivision inside the fringe; then run a return trip and check that the residual after returning to zero is below one subdivision unit, otherwise fringes are lost or the phase meter has periodic error. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 光程差、條紋與相位細分：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Optical-path difference, fringes and phase subdivision: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「量測臂、參考臂與相位計」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Measurement arm, reference arm and phase meter” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 光束被遮斷或訊號強度瞬間低於門檻時計數器掉一個或多個條紋，之後所有讀值都偏移 158.2 nm 的整數倍且無法事後修正；在機台校正中這會表現為突然出現的台階狀誤差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A beam interruption or a momentary drop of signal strength below threshold makes the counter lose one or more fringes, after which every reading is offset by an integer multiple of 158.2 nm with no possibility of later correction; in machine calibration this appears as a sudden step in the error plot. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：電子相位計把一個條紋再細分成數千等分，位移就是條紋數加上相位餘數乘以條紋週期，整個量測的長度單位來自雷射波長。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: An electronic phase meter subdivides each fringe into thousands of parts, and displacement is fringe count plus phase remainder times fringe period, so the unit of length comes from the laser wavelength.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平面鏡干涉儀每 λ/2 給一個條紋，和角隅稜鏡干涉儀一樣。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A plane-mirror interferometer gives one fringe per λ/2 just like a retroreflector interferometer." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 光束被遮斷或訊號強度瞬間低於門檻時計數器掉一個或多個條紋，之後所有讀值都偏移 158.2 nm 的整數倍且無法事後修正；在機台校正中這會表現為突然出現的台階狀誤差。
knowledge.textEn: A beam interruption or a momentary drop of signal strength below threshold makes the counter lose one or more fringes, after which every reading is offset by an integer multiple of 158.2 nm with no possibility of later correction; in machine calibration this appears as a sudden step in the error plot.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

外差式干涉儀的解析度由分頻 f_s 決定，f_s 越高解析度越好。

steps.title: 外差偵測、都卜勒頻移與速度上限：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Heterodyne detection, Doppler shift and the velocity limit: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「雙頻雷射與都卜勒拍頻」如何決定雷射干涉位移量測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Two-frequency laser and Doppler beat” determines the key performance of “Laser-interferometric displacement metrology”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 外差式干涉儀的雷射輸出兩個頻率相差 f_s 的正交偏振分量，一個進參考臂、一個進量測臂；光電偵測器看到的是 f_s 的拍頻訊號，位移資訊藏在這個拍頻相對於參考拍頻的相位差中。鏡子移動時量測光束帶都卜勒頻移，拍頻變成 f_s ± 4v/λ；相位用交流訊號量測，對雷射強度漂移與偵測器偏壓不敏感，這是外差優於零差（直流）方案的關鍵。但拍頻不能降到零或翻轉，所以分頻 f_s 直接決定可量測的最高速度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「雙頻雷射與都卜勒拍頻」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A heterodyne interferometer's laser emits two orthogonally polarised components separated by f_s; one goes to the reference arm, the other to the measurement arm, and the photodetector sees a beat at f_s whose phase relative to a reference beat carries the displacement. A moving mirror Doppler-shifts the measurement beam so the beat becomes f_s ± 4v/λ; because phase is read on an ac signal it is immune to laser-intensity drift and detector offset, the key advantage over homodyne (dc) schemes. The beat may not fall to zero or reverse, so the split frequency f_s directly sets the maximum measurable velocity. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Two-frequency laser and Doppler beat”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：雙程干涉儀的都卜勒頻移為 4v/λ：v = 1 m/s 時 4/632.8×10⁻⁹ ≈ 6.32 MHz。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Double-pass Doppler shift is 4v/λ: at v = 1 m/s it is 4/632.8×10⁻⁹ ≈ 6.32 MHz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「外差式干涉儀的解析度由分頻 f_s 決定，f_s 越高解析度越好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Heterodyne resolution is set by the split frequency f_s, so higher f_s means finer resolution." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「雙頻雷射與都卜勒拍頻」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Two-frequency laser and Doppler beat”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 外差偵測、都卜勒頻移與速度上限

A moving mirror Doppler-shifts the measurement beam so the beat becomes f_s ± 4v/λ; because phase is read on an ac signal it is immune to laser-intensity drift and detector offset, the key advantage over homodyne (dc) schemes.

knowledge.text: 誤解：外差式干涉儀的解析度由分頻 f_s 決定，f_s 越高解析度越好。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「外差偵測、都卜勒頻移與速度上限」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

optionsEn: Heterodyne resolution is set by the split frequency f_s, so higher f_s means finer resolution.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 外差偵測、都卜勒頻移與速度上限：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Heterodyne detection, Doppler shift and the velocity limit: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雙頻雷射與都卜勒拍頻」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Two-frequency laser and Doppler beat” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：雙程干涉儀的都卜勒頻移為 4v/λ：v = 1 m/s 時 4/632.8×10⁻⁹ ≈ 6.32 MHz。速度上限 v_max = f_s·λ/4：聲光調制分頻 f_s = 20 MHz 時 v_max ≈ 3.16 m/s；Zeeman 分頻 2 MHz 時只有 0.32 m/s。相位計若每 10 µs 更新一次，在 1 m/s 下每次更新之間移動 10 µm，約 63 個條紋，計數器必須以遠高於拍頻的時脈運作。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Double-pass Doppler shift is 4v/λ: at v = 1 m/s it is 4/632.8×10⁻⁹ ≈ 6.32 MHz. Velocity limit v_max = f_s·λ/4: with an acousto-optic split f_s = 20 MHz, v_max ≈ 3.16 m/s; a 2 MHz Zeeman split allows only 0.32 m/s. If the phase meter updates every 10 µs, at 1 m/s the mirror moves 10 µm between updates, about 63 fringes, so the counter clock must run far above the beat frequency. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用示波器或頻譜儀同時看參考拍頻與量測拍頻：靜止時兩者頻率相同，鏡子以定速移動時量測拍頻應偏移 4v/λ，由偏移量反算速度並與平台編碼器比較；逐步提高速度直到讀值跳動，確認失效點與 f_s·λ/4 一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Watch the reference and measurement beats together on an oscilloscope or spectrum analyser: at rest they coincide, and with the mirror moving at constant speed the measurement beat should shift by 4v/λ; back out velocity from the shift and compare with the stage encoder, then raise speed until readings break up and confirm the failure point matches f_s·λ/4.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 雙程干涉儀的都卜勒頻移為 4v/λ：v = 1 m/s 時 4/632.8×10⁻⁹ ≈ 6.32 MHz。速度上限 v_max = f_s·λ/4：聲光調制分頻 f_s = 20 MHz 時 v_max ≈ 3.16 m/s；Zeeman 分頻 2 MHz 時只有 0.32 m/s。相位計若每 10 µs 更新一次，在 1 m/s 下每次更新之間移動 10 µm，約 63 個條紋，計數器必須以遠高於拍頻的時脈運作。
knowledge.textEn: Double-pass Doppler shift is 4v/λ: at v = 1 m/s it is 4/632.8×10⁻⁹ ≈ 6.32 MHz. Velocity limit v_max = f_s·λ/4: with an acousto-optic split f_s = 20 MHz, v_max ≈ 3.16 m/s; a 2 MHz Zeeman split allows only 0.32 m/s. If the phase meter updates every 10 µs, at 1 m/s the mirror moves 10 µm between updates, about 63 fringes, so the counter clock must run far above the beat frequency.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「外差偵測、都卜勒頻移與速度上限」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Heterodyne detection, Doppler shift and the velocity limit", which statement holds?

只要實驗室溫控在 ±1 °C，干涉儀就不需要折射率補償。

With the laboratory held to ±1 °C the interferometer needs no index compensation.
An interferometer is an optical measurement, so electronic latency is not an issue.
quiz.explanation: 雙程干涉儀的都卜勒頻移為 4v/λ：v = 1 m/s 時 4/632.8×10⁻⁹ ≈ 6.32 MHz。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Double-pass Doppler shift is 4v/λ: at v = 1 m/s it is 4/632.8×10⁻⁹ ≈ 6.32 MHz. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 外差偵測、都卜勒頻移與速度上限：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Heterodyne detection, Doppler shift and the velocity limit: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「雙頻雷射與都卜勒拍頻」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Two-frequency laser and Doppler beat” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用示波器或頻譜儀同時看參考拍頻與量測拍頻：靜止時兩者頻率相同，鏡子以定速移動時量測拍頻應偏移 4v/λ，由偏移量反算速度並與平台編碼器比較；逐步提高速度直到讀值跳動，確認失效點與 f_s·λ/4 一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the reference and measurement beats together on an oscilloscope or spectrum analyser: at rest they coincide, and with the mirror moving at constant speed the measurement beat should shift by 4v/λ; back out velocity from the shift and compare with the stage encoder, then raise speed until readings break up and confirm the failure point matches f_s·λ/4. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：平台在急停或振動時瞬間超過速度上限，拍頻穿過零而相位計失去方向資訊，之後位移讀值以錯誤方向累積；系統看似正常運作，直到與編碼器對比才發現幾十微米的偏差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A stage that momentarily exceeds the velocity limit during a hard stop or vibration drives the beat through zero, the phase meter loses direction information and displacement accumulates with the wrong sign; the system appears normal until a comparison with the encoder reveals tens of micrometres of discrepancy.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用示波器或頻譜儀同時看參考拍頻與量測拍頻：靜止時兩者頻率相同，鏡子以定速移動時量測拍頻應偏移 4v/λ，由偏移量反算速度並與平台編碼器比較；逐步提高速度直到讀值跳動，確認失效點與 f_s·λ/4 一致。
knowledge.textEn: Watch the reference and measurement beats together on an oscilloscope or spectrum analyser: at rest they coincide, and with the mirror moving at constant speed the measurement beat should shift by 4v/λ; back out velocity from the shift and compare with the stage encoder, then raise speed until readings break up and confirm the failure point matches f_s·λ/4.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「外差偵測、都卜勒頻移與速度上限」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Heterodyne detection, Doppler shift and the velocity limit"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
用示波器或頻譜儀同時看參考拍頻與量測拍頻：靜止時兩者頻率相同，鏡子以定速移動時量測拍頻應偏移 4v/λ，由偏移量反算速度並與平台編碼器比較。

quiz.explanationEn: Watch the reference and measurement beats together on an oscilloscope or spectrum analyser: at rest they coincide, and with the mirror moving at constant speed the measurement beat should shift by 4v/λ; back out velocity from the shift and compare with the stage encoder, then raise speed until readings break up and confirm the failure point matches f_s·λ/4. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 外差偵測、都卜勒頻移與速度上限：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Heterodyne detection, Doppler shift and the velocity limit: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雙頻雷射與都卜勒拍頻」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Two-frequency laser and Doppler beat” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 平台在急停或振動時瞬間超過速度上限，拍頻穿過零而相位計失去方向資訊，之後位移讀值以錯誤方向累積；系統看似正常運作，直到與編碼器對比才發現幾十微米的偏差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A stage that momentarily exceeds the velocity limit during a hard stop or vibration drives the beat through zero, the phase meter loses direction information and displacement accumulates with the wrong sign; the system appears normal until a comparison with the encoder reveals tens of micrometres of discrepancy. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：但拍頻不能降到零或翻轉，所以分頻 f_s 直接決定可量測的最高速度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The beat may not fall to zero or reverse, so the split frequency f_s directly sets the maximum measurable velocity.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「外差式干涉儀的解析度由分頻 f_s 決定，f_s 越高解析度越好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Heterodyne resolution is set by the split frequency f_s, so higher f_s means finer resolution." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 平台在急停或振動時瞬間超過速度上限，拍頻穿過零而相位計失去方向資訊，之後位移讀值以錯誤方向累積；系統看似正常運作，直到與編碼器對比才發現幾十微米的偏差。
knowledge.textEn: A stage that momentarily exceeds the velocity limit during a hard stop or vibration drives the beat through zero, the phase meter loses direction information and displacement accumulates with the wrong sign; the system appears normal until a comparison with the encoder reveals tens of micrometres of discrepancy.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「外差偵測、都卜勒頻移與速度上限」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Heterodyne detection, Doppler shift and the velocity limit" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
HeNe 雷射的波長是物理常數，任何 HeNe 都可以當作長度標準。
平台在急停或振動時瞬間超過速度上限，拍頻穿過零而相位計失去方向資訊，之後位移讀值以錯誤方向累積；系統看似正常運作，直到與編碼器對比才發現幾十微米的偏差。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
The HeNe wavelength is a physical constant, so any HeNe can serve as a length standard.

A stage that momentarily exceeds the velocity limit during a hard stop or vibration drives the beat through zero, the phase meter loses direction information and displacement accumulates with the wrong sign.
quiz.explanation: 平台在急停或振動時瞬間超過速度上限，拍頻穿過零而相位計失去方向資訊，之後位移讀值以錯誤方向累積；系統看似正常運作，直到與編碼器對比才發現幾十微米的偏差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A stage that momentarily exceeds the velocity limit during a hard stop or vibration drives the beat through zero, the phase meter loses direction information and displacement accumulates with the wrong sign; the system appears normal until a comparison with the encoder reveals tens of micrometres of discrepancy. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
